newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-VASQUEZ STOPS MENDOZA TO KEEP WBA FEATHERWEIGHT TITLE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-VASQUEZ STOPS MENDOZA TO KEEP WBA FEATHERWEIGHT TITLE.

text.p: Wilfredo Vasquez of Puerto Rico pummeled Bernardo Mendoza of Chile into submission on Saturday to retain his World Boxing Association featherweight title.
In the first defence of his title, the 35-year-old Vasquez stopped Mendoza 2:37 into the fifth round of the scheduled 12-round bout to raise his record to 47-7-3.
Vasquez, winner of three world titles, was dominating the fight and was ahead on all three judge's scorecards through the first four rounds.
But he left nothing to chance.
In the fifth round, the champion connected with a straight left jab to Mendoza's face and followed with an overhand right to side of the jaw that put the challenger down on his knees.
A clearly dazed Mendoza managed to get to his feet just before the referee reached 10 in the count and attempted to continute fighting.
But Vasquez manoeuvred Mendoza over to the ropes and landed three unanswered punches, two to the head and one to the body.
The third punch -- a right to the head -- put the Chilean back on his knees and the referee stopped the fight seconds after the challenger's cornermen threw in the towel.
"I didn't think it would be that easy," Vasquez said through an interpreter. "The right hand finished him."
